SYMPTOM: Maestro flow fails with syntax error on assertVisible/tapOn with timeout property
CAUSE: Maestro 2.x changed API — timeout is not a direct property of assertVisible or tapOn
FIX: Wrap assertions in extendedWaitUntil block:
  - extendedWaitUntil:
      visible: "Element text"
      timeout: 5000
OR just remove timeouts and rely on default wait
GOTCHA: runFlow with 'when visible' condition is valid and useful for conditional flows (e.g., only dismiss onboarding if visible)
